title: SoftBank raised ~$11B in debt through its junk bond sale, making the Japanese investment firm one of the biggest corporate junk-bond borrowers in the world (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: SoftBank raised ~$11B in debt through its junk bond sale, making the Japanese investment firm one of the biggest corporate junk-bond borrowers in the world — Billionaire Masayoshi Son's SoftBank Group Corp. pushed through one of the largest junk-bond offerings on record …
